assessment: This paper marks a significant advance in understanding the transcriptional control of neural cell fate and connectivity. The authors show that a single homeodomain transcription factor has a central role in specifying the diverse neuron types of the enteric nervous system of the C. elegans pharynx. By linking cell fates across a single, largely self-contained circuit, these studies support the emerging idea that transcriptional control can link cell fate to circuit connectivity and function.
